03rd – 06th December | 4 Days / 3 Nights

Cinnamon Life at City of Dreams, Colombo

  1. Day 1 03rd Dec India – Colombo
    Arrival & Welcome Dinner

    TimeProgramme

    • —Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport, Colombo, and complete immigration formalities.
    • 09:00Airport meet and greet, as per respective flight arrival timings.
    • 10:15Proceed to Cinnamon Life at City of Dreams.
    • 11:00Welcome upon arrival.
    • 13:00Lunch at the Hotel.
    • —Leisure Time at Hotel.
    • 17:30Proceed to Bellevue Beach Club for a sundowner experience.
    • 19:30Welcome dinner at Bellevue Beach Club.
    • 22:30Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

    Dress CodeResort Casual Beach Formals

  2. Day 2 04th Dec Colombo – Bentota
    Bentota Excursion

    TimeProgramme

    • 07:30Early breakfast at the Hotel.
    • 08:30Proceed to Bentota.
    • 10:30Arrive at Captain’s Boat House for an activity briefing.
    • 10:40Moadhu River Boat Ride to see Mangrove and the Cinnamon Plantation, Life in the Small Islands
    • 12:00Return to Base
    • 12:15Proceed to Victor Hasselblad Sea Turtle Conservation Center
    • 12:25Arrive at The Turtle Conservation Center
    • 12:45Proceed to Club Bentota
    • 13:05Arrive at the Club Bentota
    • 13:15Commence Water sports activities One round Each of Jet Ski, Banana Boat Ride and Sofa ride
    • 14:00Carnival Lunch
    • 15:30Proceed to Colombo
    • 19:30Proceed to Lotus Tower - Dinner at Blue Orbit
    • 22:00Return to the Hotel.

    Note: Guests are requested to carry swimwear, a change of clothes and a personal towel for the Bentota excursion.

    Dress CodeActive Casual Swimwear Smart Casual For Dinner

  3. Day 3 05th Dec Colombo
    Award Night & Gala Dinner

    TimeProgramme

    • 09:00Breakfast at the Hotel.
    • 10:30Colombo city tour & Shopping
    • 14:00Lunch at Indian Restaurant
    • 15:00Relax at Hotel
    • 17:00Assemble at the pre function area for the Award Night, followed by Gala Dinner
    • 23:59Overnight at the Hotel

    Dress CodeFormal / Semi casual

  4. Day 4 06th Dec Colombo – India
    Departure

    TimeProgramme

    • 09:00Breakfast at the hotel
    • 11:30Check out from the hotel
    • 13:00Lunch at local Indian restaurant
    • 14:00Shopping drop (time permitting)
    • 20:15Transfer to the airport for your return flight.

    Note: Meals as per flight schedule.

    Dress CodeTravel Casual

Important Travel Reminders

  • Keep a universal travel adapter handy (Sri Lanka uses 230V electricity).
  • Carry some Sri Lankan Rupees for personal expenses.
  • Keep your mobile phone charged and ensure international roaming is active.
  • Check your baggage before leaving each hotel or venue.
  • Do not carry packages or luggage belonging to strangers.
